name: ggbank-receipt
description: Signs a work artifact with an Ed25519 receipt and verifies it offline. Proof that a file was delivered by a given agent and has not changed since.

skills.name: Issue receipt
skills.description: Sign an artifact: returns artifact sha256, agent, task, amount and an Ed25519 signature.
examples: issue a receipt for the report I just wrote

skills.name: Verify receipt
skills.description: Verify a receipt offline: signature, every field, and optionally the artifact hash.
examples: is this delivery genuine and unmodified?
